weather_report:
A quilt of overcast hangs over Subiaco in the small hours, muting the glow of the world and softening every edge. The morning looks set to wake under a low, uniform ceiling, the light dim and pewter-toned rather than bright and golden. Sunshine will be scarce at first; the UV index is negligible before sunrise and will only begin to matter if the cloud thins later. Expect a diffuse, hazy clarity that lends the streets a quiet, contemplative calm more than any sparkle.

It’s a day to start gently: pull on a light jacket or soft sweater, comfortable shoes, and keep a compact umbrella or cap in your bag if the breeze toys with the clouds. Slip out for an unhurried coffee, a lap around the block before the traffic swells, or an early errand while the town is still yawning awake. If the sky holds, window seats suit the mood—reading, planning, tidying life’s small corners. Should the cover break later, a touch of sunscreen and sunglasses won’t go astray, but for now the world is cool, muted, and kind to the eyes.
